newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher except spot July.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher except spot July.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Thursday except for the spot July contract, as local investors liquidated long positions, traders said.
Prices were 2.3 to 4.4 yen higher, and benchmark December was up 4.2 yen at 118.5 yen per kg.
The spot July, which expires on Friday, ended down 0.1 yen at 93.9 yen. As of July 23, the spot contract had 3,839 lots of open interests.
Traders said nearby months were unlikely to gain further until the spot contract expired.
